classification_rationale: 52A22 covers random convex sets and integral geometry, and the main object is affine shape and near-maximal volume of randomly inscribed simplices.
integrity: The first_public_date is the verified earliest public date of a motivating source, not a claimed publication date of this finding. Analytical proof establishes the theorem; finite checker is only corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension at least three and parent simplex only; no full density or dimension-uniform bound. Full historical Mannion paper and Alagar thesis unavailable; historical priority is provisional.
title: Second-order maximal-volume tails and conditional shape laws for random simplices
